statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Oil near $110, U.S. yields near 5% and broad Asian equity weakness keep Stress extreme; exact fresh NQ retracement and extension structure is not independently verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; a higher Tail state remains conditional on verified persistent one-way NQ structure, shallow retracements or repeated extension.
headline: Oil and global yields keep Stress extreme; Tail remains WATCH ahead of CPI
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures down 0.2%, Asian equities sharply lower, Brent near $110 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 5%. Oracle's strong after-hours results provide a technology counterweight. Exact fresh NQ path persistence is not independently verified. August CPI is due at 12:30 UTC.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved into the elevated band around September 10 PPI and the U.S. cash open, then returned to WATCH as persistent one-way NQ structure was not sustained or freshly verified. Overnight cross-asset stress remains extreme from oil and yields.
outlookSummary: Stress remains extreme from oil, rates and geopolitical supply risk. Tail stays WATCH without verified persistent NQ structure; the main conditional danger window is 12:15-14:30 UTC around CPI, the U.S. cash open and Michigan data.

forecast.analysis: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures down 0.2%, Brent near $110 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 5% as Asian equities sold off. Cross-asset Stress is extreme, but exact fresh NQ retracement and extension structure is not independently verified, so Tail remains WATCH.
drivers: Nasdaq futures down 0.2% in Reuters' latest global-markets report
Brent near $110 and U.S. 10-year yield near 5%
Exact fresh NQ path structure remains unavailable

news.title: Global bonds buckle as surging oil prices inflame inflation risks
Oil prices set to end week over $100 for first time in nearly 4 months

forecast.analysis: If early-Asia futures remain two-sided, Tail stays WATCH despite the oil-and-bond shock. A move toward persistent directional efficiency with shallow retracements would be the condition for a higher Tail band.
drivers: Oil and Treasury yields remain major cross-asset stressors
Retracement quality is the Tail checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Late-Asia Tail can ease slightly if NQ remains contained and retracements stay meaningful. Renewed extension alongside another oil or yield leg would reverse that easing.
drivers: Meaningful NQ retracements would limit Tail

forecast.analysis: Toward the Asia close, a contained futures range supports WATCH. A failed retracement followed by renewed extension would be the clearest condition for Tail to rise.
At the European open, broader risk selling may increase pressure, but a blocking Tail state remains conditional on persistent one-way NQ structure rather than regional equity weakness alone.
drivers: Persistent NQ directional efficiency remains the block trigger

news.title: Global bonds buckle as surging oil prices inflame inflation risks

forecast.analysis: Early Europe is a confirmation window: stable or retracing NQ would keep Tail in WATCH, while repeated extension with yields and oil still rising would support a higher conditional Tail estimate.
As Europe matures, pre-CPI positioning can thin liquidity. Tail stays WATCH unless the index begins holding near directional extremes with shallow pullbacks.
drivers: Session-extreme holding is a conditional Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: In the U.S. premarket, elevated oil and yields increase gap and repricing risk. Tail remains below the block threshold unless NQ develops persistent extension and poor retracement quality.
drivers: Gap risk from oil and rates

forecast.analysis: With CPI approaching, event sensitivity dominates. No hypothetical CPI surprise is treated as observed Tail evidence; the pre-release state remains WATCH unless one-way price structure develops before the release.
drivers: Pre-release NQ structure is the key checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC CPI release creates a high-dispersion checkpoint. Elevated Tail here is conditional on post-release persistence, shallow retracements or repeated extension; an orderly two-sided reaction would quickly reduce Tail.
drivers: Post-release persistence is required for elevated Tail
Orderly retracement would be an immediate easing signal

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open follows CPI by one hour. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction continuation, NQ holding near extremes and failed pullbacks; a retracing open would argue for rapid normalization.

Michigan sentiment arrives at 14:00 UTC while CPI price discovery may still be active. Tail remains conditionally elevated only if the second data wave reinforces a persistent NQ path rather than producing two-sided whipsaw.
drivers: Persistent NQ path required for elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: After the main data sequence, Tail falls back to WATCH if volatility decays and meaningful retracements appear. Continued one-way extension would invalidate that normalization.
Mid-session risk should ease if CPI repricing becomes orderly and cross-assets stabilize. Persistent oil, yield and semiconductor pressure would keep Stress high even if Tail remains WATCH.
Later U.S. trade favors lower Tail if the session has developed two-sided structure. A fresh directional leg with failed retracements would reopen the danger window.
Into the late U.S. session, WATCH remains appropriate under balanced price discovery. A synchronized move in NQ, yields and oil would be the main conditional amplifier.
drivers: Balanced price discovery would cap Tail

forecast.analysis: Power-hour Tail can rise modestly if directional efficiency increases into the close. A broad retracement or fading momentum would keep the state in WATCH.
Near the cash close, a non-extreme finish and visible retracement would support easing. Closing extension at session extremes would keep Tail elevated within WATCH.
After the cash close, Tail should ease if futures digest the session without a second one-way leg. New geopolitical or energy headlines remain the main discontinuity risk.

news.title: Oil prices set to end week over $100 for first time in nearly 4 months

forecast.analysis: Early evening futures are expected to normalize conditionally if oil and yields stop extending. Renewed cross-asset stress would delay normalization.
If no new catalyst emerges, the late-evening state can move to normal with lower Tail. A fresh geopolitical disruption or sustained NQ extension would invalidate that baseline.
Around the overnight handoff, lower Tail is conditional on stable rates, contained oil and meaningful futures retracements. Stress can remain elevated even as Tail normalizes.
In early Asia on the next session, normal conditions remain the baseline only if NQ price discovery is two-sided and no new energy or geopolitical shock appears.
By the following late-Asia hour, Tail remains low under stable cross-assets and normal retracement behavior. Any renewed persistent one-way structure would require reassessment.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed cross-asset stress is extreme, but exact fresh NQ path persistence is unverified; current Tail remains WATCH.
Early-Asia WATCH persists if futures remain two-sided; shallow pullbacks and renewed extension would raise Tail.
Late-Asia Tail eases only if NQ stays contained and retains meaningful retracements.
Asia-close WATCH assumes a contained range; a failed retracement plus extension would raise Tail.
At the European open, regional selling alone is insufficient for a block without persistent one-way NQ structure.
Early Europe is a confirmation window: stable NQ keeps WATCH; aligned oil/yield pressure plus repeated extension would raise Tail.
